name: hydra
description: HYDRA — digital management system for PSG Electrical and Cables / Trite Solar

scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @hydra/shared && npm run lint -w @hydra/api && npm run lint -w @hydra/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @hydra/shared && npm run typecheck -w @hydra/api && npm run typecheck -w @hydra/mobile
scripts.test: npm run test -w @hydra/shared && npm run test -w @hydra/api && npm run test -w @hydra/mobile
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hydra/shared && npm run build -w @hydra/api && npm run build -w @hydra/mobile
